handoff.text: Done: RAM as VRAM substitute. Jobs reserve ram = "32GiB" before they start (planner hands RAM out like cores, [resources] ram / --ram, default half of MemTotal; strict priority holds it). tablely.tables: tables.store() pins that RAM once (Arena), put() places tables on GPU within the VRAM budget else in RAM, gather/rows/set_rows/add_rows, store.guard(step) moves the biggest GPU table to RAM on OOM and reruns the step, promote() moves tables back; moves are reported to the ledger (status 'ram 6GiB/8GiB', 'ram use' line, history 'tables' events). Example: examples/ram_tables.toml + table_train.py. Next: run TorchBackend on a real GPU (pinned arena views, index_select into pinned rows, OOM detection) - only tested with FakeGpu since PyTorch can't be installed here. Caveat: a guarded step must be safe to rerun (zero grads first, updates last).
